sequentialTests.label: Entrepreneurial ventures & business innovation
sequentialTests.finding: Defining academic substance is opportunity/venture creation,innovation and businessmodels supported by businessdisciplines,data/AI,competence development and sustained project practice. The first UCR option provides actual newventureplanning/finalpitch7.5EC,customer/product/prototype/cost/sustainability development7.5EC,businessstrategy7.5EC,marketing7.5EC andactualmarketresearch7.5EC,alongside finance/accounting15EC,economics15EC,organisationalleadership/communication/negotiation45EC,businesslaw7.5EC,AIbusinesscontext7.5EC,research/data37.5EC,globalbusiness7.5EC andPPD7.5EC. This is substantive entrepreneurial/businessinnovation study,not merely adjacent management labels. The specialist sequence remains a gap.

sequentialTests.label: Corporate innovation & business analytics
sequentialTests.finding: Corporate/startup/impact contexts and the DataAnalytics/AI learning line are explicit target evidence. Reconstruct digital option:restore productdevelopment,businesslaw,econometrics and leadershipcommunication;remove excessive algorithms/deeplearning/generalsocialpsychology and the unused microeconomics course. Retain programming,math/statistics,database andAIethics as tools,not entrepreneurship substitutes. Sixcourse45ECdifferent curriculum with substantial business/venture/organisation core passes.

sequentialTests.label: Impact entrepreneurship & sustainable ventures
sequentialTests.finding: Impactentrepreneurship and socially/environmentallyvaluable ventures are explicit. Keep venture/product/strategy/market/financial work;life-cycle/circular assessment,climate,environmental science,governance and farming/energy cases define impact problems and interventions. Replace resource-recovery chemistry lab with data inquiry and a secondleadershipcourse with practicalfinance. Ninecourses67.5ECdiffer frombroad and11courses82.5ECfromcorporate. Sector-sciencecourses are complementary knowledge,not dedicated impactenterprise training.
